name: Hushwing
description:
A velvet moth with a brass bell for a head. It has had enough of being rung. Free it in {place} and it will quiet the hotel for you.

{key.summon} calls it at the resident under your reticle, within {range} paces and clear sight. Costs {cost} summon charge. Its arrival interrupts the resident, holding it still for {interrupt} seconds while you strike or retreat. It then folds its wings and leaves.
